title: The Gaze of the Demonic Path Commander
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought the blood resonance had ended, a will from the depths of the Demonic Path descended abruptly, carrying a hunger that could devour everything—the true face of the Heavenly Eye was slowly revealing itself before his eyes.

text.content: The echo of the severed karmic thread still reverberated within his Mental Sea. Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his pupils reflecting not the roof beams of the Tianqing Sect, but a blood-red Void. The moment that otherworldly will awakened, his chest felt as if gripped by an invisible giant hand, his violent heartbeat like war drums. He looked down at his chest, where a dark red pattern was slowly emerging,蠕动如同活物,散发令人窒息的古老气息。这气息与天机录上残缺的金色符文交相辉映,却带着截然不同的暴戾与疯狂。" He lowered his gaze to his chest, where a dark red pattern was slowly emerging, writhing like a living thing and emanating an ancient aura suffocating enough to stifle. This aura interweaved with the fragmented golden runes of the Tianji Record, yet carried a starkly different savagery and madness.

"Blood... resonance?" Chen Ji murmured to himself, his voice as dry as sandpaper rubbing. He had never sensed any abnormality in his bloodline, even after obtaining the Tianji Record Fragment, that innate feeling of ordinariness had never disappeared. Yet now, the dark red pattern on his chest was trembling at an eerie frequency, as if responding to some distant call. He closed his eyes, delving his Spiritual Sense into his body, attempting to trace the source of that resonance.

dialogue.content: The moment his Spiritual Sense touched the chest pattern, an elderly yet majestic voice exploded in his mind—this sound bypassed his eardrums entirely,穿透了他的意识屏障,带着亘古以来的傲慢与俯瞰: 「命运的双生子,终于肯回应本座了吗？」 那声音中蕴含的力量让陈机的神识剧烈颤抖,仿佛在狂风中的烛火,随时都会熄灭。 bearing the arrogance and overlooking gaze accumulated through the ages: 「The twin of destiny, have you finally decided to respond to this one?」 The power contained in that voice made Chen Ji's Spiritual Sense tremble violently, like a candle flame in a gale,随时都会熄灭。 on the verge of extinguishing at any moment.

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, his forehead already covered in cold sweat. He quickly surveyed his surroundings, discovering he still remained within the secret cave of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, the demonic fog arranged by Ye Qing静默笼罩着这片空间,将他与外界隔绝。然而那股来自血脉深处的呼唤却穿透了所有屏障,清晰地传递着他的存在。 quietly enveloping this space, isolating him from the outside world. Yet that call from the depths of his bloodline had penetrated all barriers, clearly announcing his existence. He lowered his gaze to his chest, the dark red pattern still writhing, like an eye just awakening,正在审视着这个世界。 surveying this world.

"Twin of destiny... Is this the true reason the Tianji Record chose me?" Chen Ji低声呢喃, murmured quietly, his mind racing through the fragments Mo Xiansheng had once revealed. The previous generation's inheritance candidate, a chess piece of fate, a game on the heavenly chessboard... These shards spun in his consciousness, gradually piecing together a possibility that chilled his spine. He was not the only chess piece. From the beginning, he never was.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, your aura is disrupted." Ye Qing's voice drifted from the depths of the fog, bearing an uncommon gravity. She approached slowly, her purple eyes flickering with ethereal light in the darkness,似乎察觉到了什么不寻常的东西: "你身上……有一股很古老的气息正在苏醒。那不是天机录的力量,是别的什么。" appearing to sense something unusual: "On you... there is an ancient aura awakening. That is not the power of the Tianji Record, it is something else." Her gaze fell upon the faintly visible dark red pattern on Chen Ji's chest, her pupils contracting sharply: "This is... bloodline forbidden technique? Where did you acquire this thing?"

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His Spiritual Sense was still wandering through his body, attempting to comprehend the information fragments that elderly voice had transmitted. "Twin of destiny," "this one," "finally responded"... Each word was like a key, pointing toward some deliberately buried truth. He spoke slowly, his voice平静得连自己都有些意外: "Not acquired, Ye Qing Saint. If I guess correctly, this is a mark originally existing within my bloodline. Someone, long ago, planted this seed within me."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's brow furrowed even tighter. She stepped forward several paces, reaching toward the dark red pattern on Chen Ji's chest. The moment her fingertips touched it, a bone-piercing cold aura沿着她的手臂蔓延而上,逼得她不得不迅速收回手。 spread along her arm, forcing her to quickly withdraw her hand. "This aura..." Her voice trembled slightly, "it closely resembles the Holy Sect's forbidden techniques, yet there are differences. More ancient, purer,不带任何邪意。 carrying no evil intent. What exactly is this?" Her gaze closely watched Chen Ji, rare fear flickering in her purple eyes: "Chen Ji, is there something else you are hiding from me?"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ye Qing, slowly shaking his head. Not denial, but genuine uncertainty about how to explain. He too had only touched the edge of this truth—before obtaining the Tianji Record, before becoming a Tianqing Sect Servant Disciple,甚至在他出生之前,某些人就已经在他体内埋下了命运的伏笔。 even before his birth, certain people had already buried the chess pieces of destiny within him. What did this mean? It meant he had never casually obtained the Tianji Record, but had been "chosen." From the beginning, he had been drawn into a grand game far beyond his imagination.

dialogue.content: At this moment, that elderly voice sounded again, this time clearer,更具压迫感: 「你在犹豫什么?本座能感知到你的困惑,也能感知到你的野心。你想打破天道的棋局,本座亦然。命运的双生子本是一体两面,分离太久,只会让我们都成为砧板上的鱼肉。」 那声音顿了顿,带上了诱惑的意味: 「本座能干扰天道之眼的感知,让它无法察觉你的布局。这是你独自奋斗百年都做不到的事情。只需要……一点微不足道的代价。」 more commanding: 「What are you hesitating about? This one can sense your confusion, can also sense your ambition. You wish to break the heavenly chess game, and so does this one. Twins of destiny are originally two sides of one entity, separated too long,只会让我们都成为砧板上的鱼肉。 only turns us both into fish on the chopping block.」 The voice paused, taking on a seductive tone: 「This one can interfere with the Heavenly Eye's perception, allowing it to not detect your schemes. This is something you could not achieve alone in a hundred years. Simply... a negligible price.」

text.content: "Interfere with the Heavenly Eye's perception..." Chen Ji喃喃重复着这几个字, repeated these words, his eyes flickering with keen light. If this were true, it would mean his greatest disadvantage all along—having his use of the Tianji Record always detected by the Heavenly Eye—would cease to exist. He could truly scheme across the world, without worry of becoming the next target of that monster. But at the same time, his reason疯狂示警。 was screaming warnings. There is no free lunch in the world, especially not from an existence calling itself "twin of destiny."

choice.prompt: That call from the depths of his bloodline蛊惑人心的低语, seducing whispers, Chen Ji had to choose between trust and vigilance. The Demonic Path Commander's proposal was enticing, but who could say whether this was merely the beginning of another trap?

choices.description: Respond to that call, establish contact with the Demonic Path Commander, attempt to obtain the ability to interfere with the Heavenly Eye
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the ability to interfere with the Heavenly Eye, greatly reducing the risk of scheming
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's true intentions remain unclear; cooperation may bring unknown costs

dialogue.content: Chen Ji深吸入一口气, took a deep breath, made his decision. He closed his eyes, slowly guiding his Spiritual Sense into the dark red pattern on his chest, proactively responding to that call from the depths of his bloodline. 刹那间, A sudden burst of磅礴的力量顺着血脉涌入他的识海, powerful force surged along his bloodline into his Mental Sea,带着令人窒息的古老气息。他的脑海中闪过无数支离破碎的画面——火海、废墟、一双布满皱纹的手正在将什么东西封印进一个婴儿体内…… bearing a suffocating ancient aura. Countless fragmented images flashed through his mind—sea of fire, ruins, a pair of wrinkled hands sealing something into an infant's body...

choices.description: Forcefully sever the blood resonance, cautiously decline the Demonic Path Commander's cooperation invitation
choices.visible_cost: Lose the opportunity to obtain crucial abilities
choices.visible_reward: Maintain the status quo, not expose more information to unknown existences
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may therefore become an enemy or shift to other targets

text.content:
Chen Ji snorted coldly and decisively severed the connection with that voice. He bit through the tip of his tongue, using his essence blood as a guide, and forcibly drew a sealing rune on his chest. The蠕动 of the dark red patterns was immediately restrained, and that ancient call became intermittent.

"You will regret this, twin of fate... The Eye of Heavenly Way has already noticed you. Facing it alone, you will only become the next sacrifice!" The voice faded away, yet left behind a chilling warning.

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing watched as the dark red patterns on Chen Ji's chest gradually subsided, but her brow did not relax: "That aura just now... is something only a figure at the level of the Holy Sect Master could possess. Who exactly have you provoked?"

Her voice carried a hint of complexity: "If you need the power of the Demonic Path to confront that person, I can help petition the Holy Sect for you. But you must tell me, what exactly are you planning?"

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer Ye Qing's question. His gaze pierced through layers of mist, falling upon some invisible coordinate in the distance. That was the direction of the Demonic Path, the direction of the Holy Sect, and also the direction where the being who called itself "Twin of Fate" resided.

Regardless of whether he chose to accept or reject, one thing was certain—he was not the only chess player in this game. Before him, someone had already set up a larger board, and he was merely one piece upon it. Or rather, both he and that being were pieces in an even greater chess game.

dialogue.content:
At this moment, a familiar ancient voice rang out in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea—it was Mo Xiansheng's voice, carrying a rare gravity:

"Master, the existence you sensed... was another former master of this old servant. His connection to the Tianji Record is far more ancient than this old servant knows. If you wish to understand the truth, you must first unseal the second page of the Tianji Record. And the key to the second page..."

Mo Xiansheng paused, his voice carrying a sigh: "Lies in your sister's hands."

text.content:
Chen Nian. This name exploded like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. His long-lost sister, the "Heavenly Fate Lock-Key" taken by the Holy Sect, the figure that existed in his foresight yet always remained blurred. So she was not merely a pawn exploited by the Holy Sect, but the key to unraveling all these mysteries.

He slowly stood up, his gaze becoming unprecedentedly resolute. No matter how fate had arranged things, he would find Chen Nian—not just for sibling affection, but to uncover the truth behind all this.

Ye Qing watched the subtle change in Chen Ji's momentum, and an indescribable feeling surged within her. She had known this man for quite some time now—from initial exploitation and calculation, to fighting side by side now—she thought she understood him well enough. But at this moment, she suddenly realized she had never truly seen through him.

This man harbored too many secrets she knew nothing about. And every secret could change the entire world's landscape.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed crucial information—Chen Nian held the key to unsealing the second page of the Tianji Record, and the Demonic Path Commander seemed to be searching for her as well. Chen Ji had to decide his next course of action.

choices.description: Taking finding his sister Chen Nian as the primary objective, as she is the key to unsealing the second page of the Tianji Record
choices.visible_cost: May expose the intention of searching
choices.visible_reward: Unseal the second page of the Tianji Record and obtain more truth about the Twin of Fate
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect may use Chen Nian as leverage

dialogue.content:
"Holy Maiden Ye, I have a request." Chen Ji turned around, his gaze fixed directly on Ye Qing's purple eyes, "I need you to mobilize the Holy Sect's intelligence network to help me find someone's whereabouts. Her name is Chen Nian, my sister, and also the 'Heavenly Fate Lock-Key' taken by the Holy Sect."

Ye Qing's expression slightly changed, clearly not expecting Chen Ji to make such a request at this time. But she quickly regained her composure and nodded: "I will help you look into it. But you need to tell me, what does she mean to you?"

choices.description: Temporarily postpone searching for Chen Nian and first investigate the Demonic Path Commander's true identity and purpose
choices.visible_cost: May miss the best opportunity to search for Chen Nian
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more information about the Demonic Path Commander and assess cooperation risks
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander may察觉 detect being investigated and take action

text.content:
Chen Ji shook his head and made a different decision: "The matter of Chen Nian can be discussed later. What matters more now is that Demonic Path Commander."

He turned to look at Ye Qing, a calculating gleam flickering in his eyes: "You are the Holy Maiden of the Holy Sect, so you should have some knowledge of the Demonic Path Commander. Tell me everything you know. His origins, his purpose, his relationship with the Holy Sect... any detail could become the key to breaking the deadlock."

dialogue.content:
Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, seemingly weighing something. Finally, she spoke, her voice low and serious:

"The Demonic Path Commander, the current sect master of the Holy Sect, is called 'Heavenly Fate.' This is a forbidden name. It is said he is a descendant of a prophet from a thousand years ago, with an inexplicable connection to the Eye of Heavenly Way."

She paused, a trace of fear flickering in her eyes: "There is a legend circulating in the Holy Sect—that Commander Heavenly Fate is not truly human, but a vessel transformed by the Heavenly Way's will. His existence itself is part of the Heavenly Way's chess game."

text.content:
"A vessel transformed by the Heavenly Way's will..." Chen Ji quietly repeated these words, his mind racing at lightning speed. If this legend were true, the identity of the Demonic Path Commander became even more intriguing. He was both a piece of the Heavenly Way and claimed to want to break the Heavenly Way's chess game—this contradiction within might be exactly the breakthrough he could exploit.

He looked up at Ye Qing, a meaningful arc curving at the corner of his mouth: "Interesting. It seems our Demonic Path Commander is far more complex than I imagined."

Just then, the dark red patterns on Chen Ji's chest trembled again—this time not because of the Demonic Path Commander's call, but because the Tianji Record itself was issuing a warning. He looked down to see the fragmented golden runes flashing at a dangerous speed, as if warning of something.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying unprecedented urgency: "Master, the Eye of Heavenly Way... it has sensed something. Although brief, that blood pulse resonance has left a trace. It is tracing the source, and will soon find this place!"

Chen Ji's gaze instantly turned sharp. He quickly surveyed his surroundings, his mind already deducing various possible developments. If the Eye of Heavenly Way came tracking, not only would he be exposed, but Ye Qing, this hidden cave dwelling, even the entire Tianqing Sect could become targets for cleansing.

He had to make a choice before the Eye of Heavenly Way arrived—fight or flee? Expose his trump cards, or abandon everything here?

dialogue.content:
"I sense it." Ye Qing's voice suddenly tensed, a rare gravity flickering in her purple eyes, "There is a force beyond the mortal world approaching. That feeling... is exactly like the Forbidden Grounds deep within the Holy Sect."

She looked at Chen Ji, seeing for the first time a凝重 expression in this man who always had every calculation planned: "The Eye of Heavenly Way has truly come. Chen Ji, what exactly have you done?"

Chen Ji did not answer. He simply stood quietly in place, watching the dark red patterns on his chest grow increasingly brighter, yet a cold smile curved at the corner of his mouth.

text.content:
"It seems our Demonic Path Commander was right." Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice unusually calm, "The Eye of Heavenly Way has noticed me. Since hiding won't work, let it come."

He turned to look at Ye Qing, a decisive gleam flickering in his eyes: "Holy Maiden Ye, what I am about to say may sound crazy to you. But please believe me—I need your Demonic Path mist to conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. Then, I will give the Eye of Heavenly Way a surprise it will never forget."

Ye Qing gazed at the familiar calculating glint in Chen Ji's eyes, and a strange sensation surged in her heart. This man was always scheming, always plotting—even when facing something as formidable as the Heavenly Dao's Eye, his first instinct was still—how to exploit it.

She suddenly understood why the Tianji Record had chosen this disciple who appeared to be a废物. Perhaps from the very beginning, he had never been a废物 at all, but rather a wolf in sheep's clothing.

"Good." She nodded, her voice resolute. "I'll help you. But remember—you owe me a favor."

Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying an indecipherable, ambiguous quality. "Rest assured, I, Chen Ji, never leave debts unpaid."

The moment those words fell, the sky beyond the cave dwelling suddenly darkened. An overwhelming pressure spread across from the horizon, as if an invisible eye was gazing down upon this land. Chen Ji looked up to see a crack in the Void slowly tearing open—on the other side lay a chaotic Void, and a massive eye that was slowly opening.

That eye held no emotion whatsoever, only pure observation and judgment. It was scanning every person below, every inch of land, every soul.

The Heavenly Dao's Eye had finally descended.

Chen Ji felt that transcendent, otherworldly power, and the dark crimson markings on his chest suddenly throbbed violently. He closed his eyes, allowing the Tianji Record's runes to flow through his body, forming some kind of bizarre equilibrium with that pressure.

The moment the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze fell upon him, a flash of information streaked across his Mental Sea like lightning—it was the voice of the Demonic Path Commander, carrying a hint of mockery and warning:

「Can you feel it? This is the gaze of the Heavenly Dao. It sees through every scheme you've made, remembers every thought you've had. You think you're playing chess, but you've always been a piece on its board.」

The voice paused, taking on an enticing quality: 「Now, you should understand why the Commander sought you out, shouldn't you?」

Chen Ji did not respond to that voice. His attention was entirely focused on that slowly scanning Heavenly Dao's Eye, feeling its all-pervading perception. The Tianji Record Fragment within him radiated a gentle warmth, as if resisting some kind of erosion.

At this moment, he discovered a subtle phenomenon—when his consciousness resonated with the dark crimson markings on his chest, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze would produce an extremely brief blind spot. That blind spot lasted less than a breath's time, but it was enough for him to do many things.

This was perhaps what the Demonic Path Commander meant by "interfering with the Heavenly Dao's Eye's perception."

Ye Qing's Demonic Path Mist was operating at full capacity, the purple fog shrouding the entire cave dwelling tightly. But under the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze, that layer of mist was dissipating visibly.

"It won't hold much longer!" Ye Qing's voice carried a hint of urgency. "This mist can deceive anyone, but not the Heavenly Dao's Eye. We have at most ten breaths of time left!"

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, a sharp gleam flickering within them. Ten breaths of time was more than enough.

Just as the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze was about to lock onto Chen Ji's position, he moved.

He formed seals with both hands, the dark crimson markings on his chest suddenly blazing brightly, interweaving with the Tianji Record's golden runes. His consciousness instantly resonated with that bloodline imprint, as if opening a door long sealed shut.

In that moment, the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze shifted briefly.

And Chen Ji had already vanished from where he stood.

Ye Qing stared blankly at the direction where Chen Ji had disappeared, her heart churning like raging waves. He had actually mastered that ability—the ability to conceal his presence under the Heavenly Dao's Eye's gaze. How many more trump cards was this man hiding?

When Chen Ji opened his eyes again, he found himself in a strange Void. All around was endless darkness and chaos, only the dark crimson marking on his chest emitting a faint glow.

"This place is..." His voice echoed in the Void, but received no response.

Just then, a gaunt and majestic figure slowly coalesced in the Void. It was an elderly man robed in black, his features obscured by darkness—only those eyes clearly visible—eyes extremely similar to the Heavenly Dao's Eye, yet carrying a completely different human warmth.

「Welcome, twin of destiny.」The figure spoke, its voice carrying a complex undertone. 「Or perhaps... welcome home.」

"Home?" Chen Ji coldly gazed at that figure, his voice devoid of any fear. "Who exactly are you? Why bring me here using blood as the lure?"

The figure let out a low, hollow laugh, that laughter carrying a hint of sentiment: 「Who am I? I am Heavenly Fate, I am the Demonic Path Commander, I am the existence sharing the same blood source as you. The Tianji Record and the Heavenly Fate Key were originally two sides of the same coin—and you and I are their masters.」

He paused, his voice turning grave and solemn: 「Or rather, we are all pieces chosen by them. Now, it is time to discuss how to break this deadlocked game.」
